contracts_reviewed: Displayed-key v4 conditions and exchange requests require the pinned binding hash, explicit model/effort and binding prompt; historical request versions reject changed input semantics.
The campaign loop requires matching agent and environment control profiles. Receipt validation and rejection parsing use that selected profile.

The bounded binding parser resolves each physical-key label to the whole native event set without menu or strategy selection. The native helper dispatches that set once, preserving exact save/calendar identity and paused simulation.
Native key confirmation, partial mutation and uncertain dispatch stay distinct. The clock probe uses an empty read-only native-event batch; no menu repair or automatic gameplay rescue is introduced.
carried_limitations: Historical receipts do not bind the Codex wrapper executable/version. This does not prove a mid-run upgrade; future studies need separately versioned provenance.
Pinned file parsing and native set dispatch do not prove physical keyboard-device equivalence or an immutable in-memory key map.
remaining_review: Other runtime/recovery dependencies and acceptance evidence not covered by the explicit prior/current review indexes.
Outcome metrics, API/viewer implementation, publication manifests and remaining integration files.
Portable setup acceptance and integration of outcomes published after this candidate snapshot.
